targetWords.definition: If someone goes or travels abroad, they go to another country.
targetWords.example: My brother wants to go abroad next year.

targetWords.definition: To anger someone is to make them mad.
targetWords.example: It angers me when people are rude.

targetWords.definition: A bride is a woman who is getting married or has just gotten married.
targetWords.example: The bride looked beautiful in her wedding dress.

targetWords.definition: If something is brief, it only lasts fora short time.
targetWords.example: The meeting this afternoon was very brief.

targetWords.definition: To chase someone or something is to follow them in order to catch them.
targetWords.example: ■I was chased by an angry native.

targetWords.definition: To disappoint is to make one feel sad or unsatisfied.
targetWords.example: I do not want to disappoint my family, so I try to do well at school.

targetWords.definition: To dive is to jump into water.
targetWords.example: I will dive into the lake once we get there.

targetWords.definition: To exchange means to give something for another thing in return.
targetWords.example: •I exchanged my foreign money for American dollars.

targetWords.definition: A favor is something you do for someone to help them.
targetWords.example: Can you do me a favor and turn off the lights?

targetWords.definition: A fee is an amount of money that a person or company asks for a service.
targetWords.example: I had to pay an hourly fee to speak with my lawyer.

story.title: The Frog Prince
story.passage:
A lovely princess sat by the pool and played with a sculpture of a bear.

Suddenly, she dropped it, and it rolled away. She chased it, but it fell into the

water. She began to cry. A large, ugly frog asked, " Why are you crying?" After the

princess told him, the frog said, " I can get the sculpture. What will you give me

in exchange for the favor?"

" I can pay you a fee in gold," she said.

But the frog protested. " I want to sleep in your bed, and you must kiss me in

the morning."

" He'd die without water. So, I don't have to keep my promise," she thought.

The frog dove for a brief moment and got the sculpture. Then the princess

ran away with it. Later, the frog went to the palace. The king told her to keep her

promise. This put the princess in a bad mood. She permitted the frog to sleep

on her pillow. In the morning, she gave him a kiss.

Suddenly, he turned into a guy. He said, " I'm from a kingdom abroad. In my

youth, I angered a tribe of cruel witches, who turned me into

a frog."

The princess asked him, " Can I be your

bride and stay with you forever?" But the

prince said, " No. You disappointed me.

You didn't keep your promise."
